items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Like Paul Bourne. Paul Bourne played saxophone clarinet too. You know Paul, don't you?

ctx.x: How was he on saxophone? I don't know about it.
He played saxophone too, I believe he played saxophone clarinet. Yeah. Like Paul Bourne. Paul Bourne played saxophone clarinet too. You know Paul, don't you? Oh, yeah.
Oh, who was in Old Man Allen's brass band? I forgot to ask you that.
